title: Tiny Trails: Space
tagline: Trace a twinkly trail from planet to planet.
summary: A calm tracing game. Follow a glowing path across little planets and meet a friendly star at the end.
studio_summary: A calm tracing game. Little fingers follow a gentle trail, one small world at a time.
description: Tiny Trails: Space is a calm tracing game for ages 3 to 6. Follow a glowing trail across little planets and meet a friendly star at the end.
free_content: Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds.
unlock: All 10 worlds and every explorer. No subscription.
trial: One shared 3-use trial lets your child try locked worlds and explorers first.
web_note: The browser version includes the free content.

hero.alt: A smiling little astronaut in a bubble helmet waves from a glowing trail that loops past little planets.

og.alt: Tiny Trails: Space. A smiling little astronaut waves from a glowing trail among the planets.

highlights.text: Trace the path with a finger. The trail lights up as the explorer moves.
Visit little planets, each with its own look. Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds are open from the start.
Pick a little explorer to guide along the trail. More explorers come with the one-time unlock.
No timers and nothing to read. Play again whenever you like.
